text:
hana: quick alert  publishing the sample-app SDK tripped the release gate. CI says semver bump from typegen diffs but the diff is just a generic parameter reordering + added @deprecated JSDoc on an internal helper.
ci-bot: pipeline #5033 failed at release: https://ci.example.com/5033 (exit 1)
diego: minimal diff from generated:```diff
- export interface Page<T, Meta = {}> { items: T[]; meta?: Meta }
+ export interface Page<Meta = {}, T> { items: T[]; meta?: Meta }
```Semver tool treats reorder of generic params as surface change -> minor.
mira: the generator changed how it emits type parameter lists upstream (tooling v4.0.0). That was intended to keep defaults adjacent to their params, but downstream semver checker doesn't normalize param order.
hana: also the e2e onboarding harness started failing when retry adds an "x-retry-id" header on subsequent attempts; our equality asserts in tests assume headers identical across attempts.
plotter-bot: created issue #1166: "generic param ordering + regen-only JSDoc causing auto-minor" and attached CI logs.
diego: proposed immediate mitigations: (1) add a normalization pass that sorts generic params by original source-order when running semver-check, (2) have release-bot mark PRs with label "regen-only" and stop auto-minor, (3) update tests to ignore x-retry-id for header equality.
mira: I can add normalization. idea: generate a canonicalization map using the swagger operationId -> param templates so semver-check rewrites Page<Meta, T> -> Page<T, Meta> for comparison. will prototype a script `tools/normalize-generics.js`.
hana: I'll take the test change and make header asserts tolerant: `expect(headersWithout(['x-retry-id'])).toEqual(expected)`. small PR.
diego: I'll update release-bot config: ignore auto-minor if only files under `generated/` or `docs/generated/` changed, and require manual approval. then unpause auto-release after manual verification.
plotter-bot: added label suggestion to PR #7289: `regen-only` when normalization passes.
ci-bot: rerun job #5034 triggered by hana (test fix).
diego: long-term we should update typegen to preserve original generic param order by default or emit a stable annotation comment so normalizer can map reliably. I'll open an upstream issue against tools/typegen.
mira: good call. will land normalize-generics.js with unit tests in the release pipeline so semver-check runs on normalized output.
hana: thanks team. once the three small PRs land let's canary publish to staging and verify consumers. leaving notes in the release runbook and tagging owners on the issue. :white_check_mark:
